title: Easy Pumpkin and Cheese Risotto
subtitle: baked in the oven, no stirring
description: A hands-off oven risotto with pumpkin, kale and feta, finished with plenty of grated Grana Padano.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a heavy metal ovenproof pan over medium heat and fry the chopped eschalots for 2 minutes until lightly golden. Add the garlic and thyme and fry, stirring, for about 1 more minute. Add the rice and fry for about 3 minutes, until the tips of the grains turn slightly translucent. Season with salt and pepper.

Add the white wine and cook, stirring, over medium heat for about 4 minutes until fully absorbed. Add the evenly diced pumpkin and the vegetable stock (or water), stir and bring to the boil. Add the chopped kale and the feta and stir.
Cover the pan with a lid or foil and bake for about 20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed. Remove the lid and bake for about 5 more minutes to brown.
Sprinkle with Grana Padano and serve immediately.
